# Declarative API

3 endpoints. Request and response schemas are described on the [schemas page](schemas.md); the other tags are listed in the [API index](README.md).

## Endpoints

### `GET /api/v1/admin/declarative`

List declarative ownership markers

List the objects created or adopted by `oa apply` (admin only)

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Ownership markers | `application/json`: [DeclarativeObjectList](schemas.md#declarativeobjectlist) |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

### `PUT /api/v1/admin/declarative`

Upsert declarative ownership markers

Upsert markers by (kind, name) in one transaction; at most 1000 items (admin only)

**Request body** (required)

`application/json`: object

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `items` | array of object | yes | - |
| `items[].applied_hash` | string | no | Maximum length: 128. |
| `items[].kind` | string | yes | One of: `User`, `Project`, `Group`, `Repository`, `PermissionTarget`, `SSOProvider`, `Webhook`, `StorageTier`, `TierPolicy`. |
| `items[].name` | string | yes | Minimum length: 1. Maximum length: 512. |
| `items[].object_id` | string | yes | Minimum length: 1. Maximum length: 256. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Stored markers | `application/json`: [DeclarativeObjectList](schemas.md#declarativeobjectlist) |
| `400` | Validation failed | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

### `DELETE /api/v1/admin/declarative`

Delete a declarative ownership marker

Remove one marker (admin only); the managed object itself is untouched

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | query | string | yes | - |
| `name` | query | string | yes | Object name; may contain `/` |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Marker deleted | - |
| `400` | Validation failed | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `404` | No such marker | - |
